headline: From Yongsan and Gangnam to Seocho Idle Land: Outline of 'Yeongkkeul' Supply Measures Following Tax Changes
summary: The South Korean government plans to unveil a housing plan as early as mid-August to supply more than 50,000 additional homes in the Seoul metropolitan area. The plan follows tax changes.
why: Housing supply and tax policy in the Seoul metropolitan area shape property prices, construction activity and household wealth in South Korea's largest economic region.
